narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion has $4.2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.1B. Obligations are up 18.5% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a rising profile from FY21 through FY26: FY21 was $3.1B, FY22 was $3.6B, FY23 was $3.5B, FY24 was $3.5B, FY25 was $3.6B, and FY26 is $4.2B. The Department of Defense is the largest buyer in FY2026 to date with $2.3B in obligations. The Department of Energy is the second buyer in FY2026 to date with $1.9B in obligations. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial because the period is FY2026 to date. This summary focuses on obligations, award counts, average award size, recent year-by-year obligations, and the top buying agencies for the current fiscal year to date.
